subject.title: feat(config): add compaction.thinkingLevel to override thinking level during compaction

question: Should OpenClaw add `agents.defaults.compaction.thinkingLevel` as a supported public config key for compaction-only reasoning control?
rationale: The patch adds a new user-facing config surface, and repository policy requires maintainer intent before growing config defaults even when the implementation is repairable.

options.title: Accept after wiring and docs
options.body: Approve the new key only after the PR wires it through all local compaction paths and documents scope, valid values, and Codex-native behavior.

options.title: Decline the new config key
options.body: Keep compaction tied to the session/default thinking level and ask users to control costs through existing model/session defaults instead.

options.title: Narrow to an existing setting
options.body: Avoid a new key by extending an existing compaction or thinking default surface if maintainers prefer one source of truth.

recommendation.title: Accept after wiring and docs
recommendation.body: Approve the new key only after the PR wires it through all local compaction paths and documents scope, valid values, and Codex-native behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to this PR and has direct recent history around compaction config/runtime paths.
